sections.dosage_and_administration: Dosage and Administration Cyanocobalamin Injection is a sterile injectable solution containing cyanocobalamin 2 mg/mL supplied in a 30 mL multi-dose vial for intramuscular or subcutaneous administration. Dosage and frequency of administration should be individualized by the prescribing healthcare provider based on the severity of deficiency, patient condition, laboratory monitoring, and therapeutic response. Administer by intramuscular or subcutaneous injection only. Administration should be performed by a licensed healthcare professional under appropriate medical supervision. This product is not intended for self-administration by the patient. Inspect the solution visually prior to administration. Do not use if the solution is cloudy, discolored, or contains particulate matter, or if the container closure is damaged. Use aseptic technique during withdrawal and administration. Follow applicable facility procedures for handling, storage, beyond-use dating after puncture, and disposal of multi-dose vials.
sections.contraindications: Contraindications Cyanocobalamin Injection is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to cyanocobalamin, vitamin B12 preparations, cobalt, benzyl alcohol, or any component of the formulation. Hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylactic shock and death, have been reported following parenteral administration of cyanocobalamin. Administration to patients with hereditary optic nerve atrophy (Leber’s disease) may result in severe and rapid optic nerve atrophy.
